items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: to take care of my brother Freddy, my sister Elsa and me

ctx.x: What were you doing? Playing bass underage or something?

No, I didn't even know bass existed in those days. I was living with my grandmother. My father couldn't take care of us because my mother died so he sent for his mother from Italy and set her up in an apartment house on Bleeker Street to take care of my brother Freddy, my sister Elsa and me. And my grandmother didn't know a word in English so I had a hard time learning English until I went to school, you know.
Well where did you go to school?
